scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node lib/test/levelCurve.test.js && node lib/test/economy.test.js && node lib/test/awardReward.test.js && node lib/test/pointsBuff.test.js && node lib/test/streak.test.js && node lib/test/payoutFeed.test.js && node lib/test/dailyGoals.test.js && node lib/test/leaderboard.test.js && node lib/test/redemption.test.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "node functions/lib/test/smoke.js"
scripts.test:rules: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node functions/lib/test/rules.test.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "node functions/lib/test/smoke.js && node functions/lib/test/rules.test.js"
